page: Amazon Web Services c7i.2xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance powered by the Nitro hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs derived from 4 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8488C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by 16.0 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 5 GHz, which yields 2.0 GB of RAM per core. This instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, and it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations show average performance across most CPU-bound workloads. The instance achieved a Geekbench single-core score of 1926.0 and a multi-core score of 7695.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 13119.77. It demonstrates strong performance in single-threaded gzip compression at 32.73 GB/sec and text processing at 2743.0. However, memory-bound operations represent a performance tradeoff, as evidenced by a weak Passmark memory score of 1800.86 and a weak text generation speed of 6.32 tokens/sec during medium (7B) LLM inference.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the c7i.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density for compute-centric workloads that do not demand high memory-to-CPU ratios or local storage. It is suitable for tasks such as static web serving, where it achieves a throughput of 14.81 GB/sec, as well as software compilation, ray tracing, and Redis database operations.
